title: FR Y-14Q Information Collection Q&As
summary: This Federal Reserve page aggregates FAQ responses clarifying reporting requirements for the FR Y-14Q Capital Assessments and Stress Testing Information Collection. The Q&As address technical bank regulatory reporting matters including lien position reporting, PPP loan inclusion, convertible securities classification, and Basel parameter calculations. The content is regulatory/compliance documentation with no direct relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: FR Y-14Q Schedule A.4 and A.5 require reporting international home equity and first lien mortgage loans as of the report date, per FR Y-9C definitions.
Schedules H.1 (Corporate Loan) and H.2 (Commercial Real Estate) require reporting lien status as of the report date per current instructions.
Convertible available-for-sale debt securities issued by non-publicly traded entities should be reported on Schedule F as Private Equity, not on Schedule B.
For Schedule A.9 summary variable B.5 ($ Commitments), firms should report total commitment amounts regardless of funding status and including all amounts reportable in FR Y-9C Schedule HC-L.
Basel fields (PD and LGD) for Schedule A.2 should be calculated as simple account-weighted averages, not dollar-weighted.
Accounts with partial charge-offs with remaining unpaid principal balances should not be included in # of accounts and $ outstanding summary variables for Schedule A.
